sql.query: SELECT ev.value, ev.name, fa.dateacct, COALESCE(bp.name, fa.description) AS groupbyname, fa.amtacctdr, fa.amtacctcr, (fa.amtacctdr - fa.amtacctcr) AS total, bp.name AS bpname, p.name AS productname, pj.name AS projectname FROM fact_acct fa JOIN c_elementvalue ev ON ev.c_elementvalue_id = fa.account_id LEFT JOIN c_bpartner bp ON bp.c_bpartner_id = fa.c_bpartner_id LEFT JOIN m_product p ON p.m_product_id = fa.m_product_id LEFT JOIN c_project pj ON pj.c_project_id = fa.c_project_id WHERE fa.ad_client_id IN ('__CLIENT_ID__') AND fa.factaccttype NOT IN ('R', 'C') AND ('__DATEFROM__' = '' OR fa.dateacct >= '__DATEFROM__'::date) AND ('__DATETO__' = '' OR fa.dateacct <= '__DATETO__'::date) AND ('__BPARTNERID__' = '' OR fa.c_bpartner_id = '__BPARTNERID__') AND ('__PRODUCTID__' = '' OR fa.m_product_id = '__PRODUCTID__') AND ('__ORGID__' = '' OR fa.ad_org_id = '__ORGID__') AND ('__ACCTSCHEMAID__' = '' OR fa.c_acctschema_id = '__ACCTSCHEMAID__') AND ('__PROJECTID__' = '' OR fa.c_project_id = '__PROJECTID__') AND ('__FROMACCOUNTID__' = '' OR ev.value >= '__FROMACCOUNTID__') AND ('__TOACCOUNTID__' = '' OR ev.value <= '__TOACCOUNTID__') ORDER BY ev.value, ev.name, fa.dateacct
sql.openingQuery: SELECT ev.value, ev.name, bp.name AS bpname, p.name AS productname, pj.name AS projectname, COALESCE(SUM(fa.amtacctdr), 0) AS openingdr, COALESCE(SUM(fa.amtacctcr), 0) AS openingcr, COALESCE(SUM(fa.amtacctdr - fa.amtacctcr), 0) AS openingtotal FROM fact_acct fa JOIN c_elementvalue ev ON ev.c_elementvalue_id = fa.account_id LEFT JOIN c_bpartner bp ON bp.c_bpartner_id = fa.c_bpartner_id LEFT JOIN m_product p ON p.m_product_id = fa.m_product_id LEFT JOIN c_project pj ON pj.c_project_id = fa.c_project_id WHERE fa.ad_client_id IN ('__CLIENT_ID__') AND ('__DATEFROM__' = '' OR fa.dateacct < '__DATEFROM__'::date) AND ('__BPARTNERID__' = '' OR fa.c_bpartner_id = '__BPARTNERID__') AND ('__PRODUCTID__' = '' OR fa.m_product_id = '__PRODUCTID__') AND ('__ORGID__' = '' OR fa.ad_org_id = '__ORGID__') AND ('__ACCTSCHEMAID__' = '' OR fa.c_acctschema_id = '__ACCTSCHEMAID__') AND ('__PROJECTID__' = '' OR fa.c_project_id = '__PROJECTID__') AND ('__FROMACCOUNTID__' = '' OR ev.value >= '__FROMACCOUNTID__') AND ('__TOACCOUNTID__' = '' OR ev.value <= '__TOACCOUNTID__') GROUP BY ev.value, ev.name, bp.name, p.name, pj.name
